title: fix(plugin-view,console,layout,components,fields): name and nest the controls axe flagged on the list and settings pages (objectui#11690)
body:
Fixes #11690
Clause-②: yes

Screen readers can name and reach the controls axe flagged on the showcase task list and on Setup → Settings → Authentication. Each traced producer is pinned with axe-core at component level. Implemented by session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8` (seat `domain:ui#3`, claim comment 6018454300).

## What changed, by producer

| axe rule (card count) | Producer found | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `button-name` (showcase, 1 of 12): `view-tab-add` | `packages/plugin-view/src/ViewTabBar.tsx` | `aria-label` and tooltip read the existing `view.addView` key (the tooltip was a hard-coded "Add View") |
| `aria-required-parent` x4, `nested-interactive` x1 | `ViewTabBar.tsx`: each view was `role="tab"` with no tablist, and the active view's actions button sat inside its tab | Each view is a `button` (the current one has `aria-current="true"`). The actions button is now its sibling inside a role-less frame. The rename box now sits outside the button and is named via `view.rename` |
| `button-name` (showcase, 11 of 12) | `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx`: select-all and per-row Radix checkboxes (a `button` with role checkbox), unnamed | named via the existing `table.selectAllRows` / `table.selectRow` keys; en defaults added to `TABLE_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` |
| `aria-progressbar-name` x10 | `packages/fields/src/index.tsx`, `PercentCellRenderer` only | the bar is `aria-labelledby` its formatted value span, so the name is in the viewer's locale |
| `label` x15, `button-name` x9 (settings) | `apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsField.tsx`: the row's `Label` had no `htmlFor` | label bound by `htmlFor` (inputs, textarea, switch, select trigger, domain combobox, colour). The radio group, multiselect group and colour hex box use `aria-labelledby` |
| `list` / `listitem` x50 (settings) | `packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx`: with drag-to-reorder on (the desktop default), each sortable row was a `div` between the menu `ul` and its `li` | the sortable node is the row's own `li`. A separator (an `aria-hidden` item) and a nested group inside a menu now root at an `li` too |

**Why buttons and not a fixed tablist.** A `tab`'s children are presentational, so a focusable button inside it is `nested-interactive`. A `tablist` may own only tabs, so the same button beside a tab is `aria-required-children`. Under tab roles the per-view actions button could be neither reachable nor valid. These views also never had the tabs keyboard model (arrow keys, a tab panel): every view was its own Tab stop, which is a button. Enter or Space switches to it when the bar is not reorderable, as the console renders it. With drag-to-reorder on, both keys start dnd-kit's keyboard drag instead, measured the same before and after this PR. Keyboard reach is unchanged: view, then its actions button, then the next view. The layout keeps its measure (`ml-2 mr-3` on the moved trigger equals the old gap plus `ml-0.5` plus the tab's right padding). The changeset marks the `role="tab"` / `aria-selected` removal as breaking for anything that queried by them.

**Where the producer was outside the expected surface.** The dispatch allowed a fix at the producer when it was measured elsewhere. That happened twice. `NavigationRenderer.tsx`: the claim's surface covers list nesting "wherever on the settings page". `data-table.tsx`: the 11 other unnamed buttons on the task list. Attributing those 11 to the data table is an inference, not a page reading. A component axe run on `data-table` reproduces `button-name` on exactly the select-all plus one-per-row checkboxes. The showcase task list renders 10 rows (the card's `aria-progressbar-name` x10), and 1 + 10 = 11.

## Pins and the reverse verification

Five new pins. Each runs axe-core 4.13 with tags wcag2a + wcag2aa (`color-contrast` off, because it needs layout happy-dom does not compute and is out of this card). Each asserts an empty violation list AND that the relevant rules appear in `passes`, so a zero there is a reading:

- `packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ViewTabBar.a11y-11690.test.tsx`: static and drag-reorderable bars, rename state, keyboard-reach checks, add-button name read in zh against the pack
- `apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsField.labelBinding-11690.test.tsx`: every input type; each control's accessible name equals its own row label
- `packages/fields/src/__tests__/PercentCellRenderer.barName-11690.test.tsx`: name equals the shown value in de (`1.235 %`)
- `packages/layout/src/__tests__/NavigationRenderer.listNesting-11690.test.tsx`: grouped and group-free menus, reorder on and off, with separators and a nested group; every `ul` child is an `li`
- `packages/components/src/__tests__/data-table-selection-names-11690.test.tsx`: names read in de against the pack

Reverse verification, from the committed fix `1ebcf6d`. Each source file was put back to base `7300fca`, its pin run, then restored with `git checkout HEAD`. The restore was proven by the HEAD blob hash; final `git diff HEAD` was empty:

| source restored to base | pin result on base | violations axe reported |
|---|---|---|
| `ViewTabBar.tsx` | 6 failed / 1 passed of 7 (the pass is the unchanged click-to-switch) | `aria-required-parent`, `button-name`, `nested-interactive`, `label` |
| `SettingsField.tsx` | 15 failed of 15 | `button-name`, `label` |
| `fields/src/index.tsx` | 4 failed of 4 | `aria-progressbar-name` |
| `NavigationRenderer.tsx` | 4 failed of 4 | menus hold non-`li` children |
| `data-table.tsx` | 2 failed of 2 | `button-name` |

One existing pin was re-pointed: `NavigationRenderer.groupedReorder-11626.test.tsx` counted the sortable wrappers as `[data-sidebar="menu"] > div`. That is exactly the defect. It now counts `> li` with the same intent (one sortable row per drawn entry, none focusable) and also asserts no non-`li` child.

## Verification (head `1ebcf6d`; console compile and settings suite re-run on `c8699a0` and `aaa5bfc`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` at the repo root: `packages/plugin-view/` 66 files / 615 tests passed; `packages/layout/` 39 / 348; `packages/fields/` 235 passed, 1 skipped / 3670 tests; `packages/components/` 362 passed, 1 skipped / 3681 tests; `apps/console/src/pages/settings/` 10 / 80
- consumer sweeps (the tab bar's role change is a public DOM change): app-shell `ObjectView.*` tests 39 / 332; every app-shell and console test naming `UnifiedSidebar` or `NavigationRenderer` 22 / 167; plugin-grid and plugin-list tests driving checkboxes by role 12 / 101; all green
- `pnpm --filter PKG type-check` exit 0 for plugin-view, layout, fields and components (script echoed `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`). The dependency closure was built first. Each new pin was confirmed inside its package's test program with `--listFilesOnly`
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the 11 touched files: 0 errors. Warning counts on the 5 source files equal the base's
- `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, plus `check-changeset-presence` / `-no-major` / `-fixed` / `-overwrite`: all exit 0
- NOT MEASURED: page-level axe on the two pages. Reason: this container has no backend. The sibling objectstack checkout has no install or build, and an objectstack showcase server is a full-farm build. The card's two-page pin is therefore carried by the component pins above plus the count mapping in the first table.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check` exit 0 on `c8699a0`, against the built 34-package closure. Round 1 (`1ebcf6d`) failed the console build with TS6133 on an unused `React` import in the new settings pin; `c8699a0` removes it. A planted leg (the pin at `1ebcf6d`) reproduces exactly that one error.
- `SettingsIcons.knownName-11679.test.tsx` (the objectui#11679 pin beside `SettingsField.tsx`) failed shard 7 on `ec3561d` with an act() warning naming `ForwardRef`. The lucide `DynamicIcon` sets its icon data from a promise, and `vi.waitFor` left `IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT` on, so the update was an act violation whenever it landed after `findByText` restored the flag. This is pre-existing on main: a throwaway in-process harness repeating the test sequence logged it on `6be0f7a` (2 of 550) as on this branch (5 of 550), and never with the RTL `waitFor` (0 of 550 on both). `aaa5bfc` waits with the RTL `waitFor`; `iconNoise()` and its assertion are unchanged. On `aaa5bfc`: the isolated test passed 40 of 40 under 4 CPU burners and the whole file 10 of 10; console type-check exit 0; settings suite 10 files / 80 tests.
- NOT MEASURED: a visual check of the tab bar in a browser (same no-backend reason).

`origin/main` has moved since base (`7a2c60b`, objectui#11725, also edits `data-table.tsx`, in a different region). `git merge-tree` against current main is clean.

## Clause-② note

The claim declared `Clause-②: yes` because it expected new language-pack keys. The diff adds none: every new name reads a key the packs already carried (`view.addView`, `view.rename`, `table.selectAllRows`, `table.selectRow`). No export, prop or type member changes either. What does change publicly is the tab bar's DOM: `role="tab"` / `aria-selected` become `button` / `aria-current`, and the changeset says so as breaking under `minor`. The seat can judge whether `yes` still applies.

## Acceptance notes (observed, not filed, no carrier)

- `ViewTabBar` still renders English literals for "Unsaved changes", "Save as View", "Reset", the "Active filters" / "Active sort" tooltip, and `aria-roledescription` "view tab" (drag mode). The packs already have `view.unsavedChanges`, `view.saveAsView`, `view.activeFilters`, `view.activeSort`. `data-table` row actions carry `aria-label` "Row actions" in English. All are named, so none is in this card's rules.
- A settings `slider` row: the Radix thumb has no accessible name (the shadcn primitive is a no-touch zone). The authentication page has no slider, so it was not measured on a page.
- `check:i18n-dead-keys` (report-only) lists `view.addView` and `view.rename` as needs-review. It cannot see call sites made through the file-local `viewTabLabel` helper.
- Dispatch hypothesis 6 is half false: `axe-core` and `vitest-axe` are root devDependencies, but no test in the tree ran axe before this PR. The cited app-shell hit is the word "relaxed".
- Every row checkbox has the same name ("Select row"), not one per record.

Related: objectui#11689 (seat 2) edits `BooleanCellRenderer` in `packages/fields/src/index.tsx`. This PR touches only the `PercentCellRenderer` region there. The later lander merges.
